title: Battleworn Dummy
description:
As you approach, it begins to rumble and fizzle and lights up brilliantly!

"[jitter]BZZZT![/jitter] TIME TO TRAIN!!! YOU HAVE [blue]3 TURNS[/blue] TO DEFEAT ME!
CHOOSE A SETTING OR FACE [red]LETHAL HUMILIATION[/red].
Here are the options:"

After the terrifying message, the dummy carefully reads out detailed instructions.

What do you choose?

options.title: Setting 1
options.description: Fight a [blue]{Setting1Hp}[/blue] HP dummy. Procure [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Potion[/gold].

options.title: Setting 2
options.description: Fight a [blue]{Setting2Hp}[/blue] HP dummy. [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] random cards.

options.title: Setting 3
options.description: Fight a [blue]{Setting3Hp}[/blue] HP dummy. Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].

notes:
This is a combat training event with three difficulty settings.

[gold]Combat Details:[/gold]
You have 3 turns to defeat the training dummy. If you run out of time, you lose the event and receive humiliation. Victory grants a reward based on which setting you chose.

[gold]Dummy HP scaling:[/gold]
Dummy HP values are scaled based on the number of players and your current run progress, shown by the {Setting1Hp}, {Setting2Hp}, and {Setting3Hp} placeholders. These values will vary based on your specific run.

[gold]Victory Rewards:[/gold]
- [blue]Setting 1:[/blue] 1 random Potion (from your character's pool + shared potions)
- [blue]Setting 2:[/blue] Upgrade 2 random cards from your deck
- [blue]Setting 3:[/blue] 1 random Relic from the relic pool

[gold]Defeat Consequence:[/gold]
If you can't defeat the dummy in 3 turns, you lose the event and cannot proceed without dying. This is effectively a lethal threat.
